parties.respondent: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change and Ors.

summary: Amnesty Scheme under 2020 Advisory upheld; declarants immune from prosecution or action under amended Wild Life (Protection) Act, 1972; amendment cannot retroactively criminalize possession; Rules under Section 49M(9) not yet framed, provisions non-operative; recommendation to extend Advisory for minimum six months with public notice; no clarification/modification of 08.08.2022 order required; application dismissed.
legal_provisions_cited: Wild Life (Protection) Act, 1972 Chapter VB, Schedule IV
Article 20(1) of the Constitution of India
T. Barai Vs. Henry Ah Hoe
Union of India vs. M/s. Ganpati Dealcom Pvt. Ltd.
final_judgment: Miscellaneous Application dismissed; no clarification of 08.08.2022 order granted; amnesty protection confirmed; recommendation issued for extended advisory period before rule-making.
